name: Chatlio
description: Embeds the Chatlio live-chat widget site-wide with condition-based visibility and optional user identification.
project_description:
A simple module for implementation of Chatlio live chat.

 Requirements 
 - Account on Chatlio service.

 Installation 
 Download and enable as a normal module.

 Configuration 
 
 Login into Chatlio with credentials. 
 Copy the embed code from https://chatlio.com/app/#/setup 
 Go to the widget settings page admin/config/services/chatlio . 
 Insert the code under "Chatlio code" 
 (Optional) Set up if necessary visibility settings. 
 
 Uninstalling 
 Uninstall as a normal module.

 Back to top
